data.gender_notes: Kalanvansh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Kalanvansh is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Kala’ meaning ‘Time’ and ‘Vansh’ meaning ‘Descendants’ or ‘Lineage’. This name signifies someone who belongs to the lineage of Kala, a significant deity in Hindu mythology. In Hindu tradition, Kala is often depicted as the God of Time and Destiny, and is believed to control the cosmic cycle of creation and destruction.
data.spiritual_meaning: Bearing the legacy of the divine God of Time and Destiny.
data.etymology: Kalanvansh belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Descendant of Kala.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kalanvansh total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

historical_references.reference: The Mahabharata mentions the Kuru-Pandava war, in which the Kuru prince Bhishma was the grandsire of the Pandava prince Bhima. The Kuru dynasty is referred to as the 'Kalanvansh' in the text.
historical_references.context: An epic poem originating in ancient India, the Mahabharata narrates the Kuru-Pandava war and the origins of the ancient Indian civilization.

historical_references.reference: The Vayu Purana, an ancient Hindu scripture, records the genealogy of the Pandava prince Yudhishthira. It mentions that the Pandavas belonged to the 'Kalanvansh', which is a branch of the Kuru dynasty.
